meta_data.base_class: Fetch the current selling price of a specific <product> sold by a company - refers to any commercially distributed item belonging to a distinct product category, whose market price can be tracked individually when associated with a seller.

tool_template.name: corporate_finance.<class>_price
tool_template.description: Fetch the current selling price of a <class> sold by a specific company.

product.description: The name of <class> whose price we want to fetch.

currency.description: The currency code (e.g., USD, EUR) in which the price of the <product> should be fetched.

region.description: The geographical region where the current selling price of the <product> is to be fetched.

date.description: The specific date for which the selling price of the <product> is requested.

include_discount.description: A flag indicating whether any available discounts should be applied to the fetched selling price of the <product>.

price_source.description: The preferred source or platform from which the price information for the <product> should be retrieved.
